_comment: OpenCode Go gateway. One API key reaches four wires. Exact catalog protocol hints override inferred family defaults; unfamiliar families use Chat Completions. Every wire carries the x-opencode-session prompt-cache affinity header (Adapter code). Chat replays readable reasoning_content only (OpenCode's own client never replays reasoning_details) and gives every historical Tool Call a reasoning_content carrier, empty when the call had no readable Reasoning: DeepSeek's thinking mode rejects a Tool Call without it. Responses is stateless (store false), takes only max_output_tokens (max_tokens maps onto it) and top_p, and structured output on every Model; its default ladder has no none rung because the gateway rejected an explicit none (live 2026-08-25), so only a Model whose ladder lists none sends it. Models that cannot stop reasoning get their cheapest rung for none. Replay scope is full_history, also where an upstream preserved-thinking contract is stronger than a particular gateway measurement; only Qwen replays tool_turns. GLM 5.3 Flash drops calls to Tools outside the request's Tool list, so Tools announced mid-Session are listed there.

family_defaults.note: Infer Responses for new versions of the gateway's existing GPT, Grok and Muse families; exact catalog protocol hints win.
New Go GPT versions inherit the current GPT Luna effort ladder when the catalog reports no ladder.
Go serves these families on Messages. This is a fallback for missing catalog hints, scoped to this Provider.
New Go Claude versions inherit the current Claude Haiku5.5 effort ladder when the catalog reports none.
Infer native Gemini and the current Gemini4 Argon Contributor effort ladder for new versions. Exact catalog protocol and ladder facts win.

New DeepSeek versions inherit the current Go Flash thinking switch and fallback effort ladder. Exact catalog support, ladder and response-field facts win; older V4 ids retain their existing controls below.
Infer the current Go Grok effort controls for new versions; none asks for the lowest supported effort instead of the Provider's higher default.
New Go GLM versions inherit the current GLM5.3 effort ladder when the catalog reports none. The earlier GLM5.1 fallback remains explicit below.
New Kimi generations inherit the current Go K3 effort controls. Exact earlier K2 controls remain corrections; reported ladders and response fields override these defaults.
New versions inherit the latest Go MiMo V2.6 and LongCat 2.5 binary thinking controls. Earlier versions with different controls remain exact exceptions.

rules.note: Preserve Go GLM5.1's established effort-only fallback; its catalog supplies no ladder. Later versions inherit the current GLM5.3 ladder.
The GPT Models (gpt-5.6-luna, gpt-6-luna) answer top_p with HTTP 400 {"model": ...}, which names no parameter, so it cannot be learned; Grok and Muse Spark accept it (live 2026-10-03).
Preserve the existing effort-only controls of these older Go V4 Models. The inferred current-family switch is for new versions, not a re-verification of legacy routes.
Preserve these earlier Go Models' existing effort-only rendering; the current family default does not re-verify legacy controls.
Hy and Kimi answer with readable reasoning plus reasoning_details; their history still replays reasoning_content.

These Models answer with readable reasoning_content; the listing carries no response-field hint for most of them. deepseek-flash is the gateway alias of DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, so both ids resolve alike.
DeepSeek's thinking switch is independent of its effort ladder: thinking stays enabled by default and with an effort; none disables it and sends no effort.
Binary thinking.type switch, enabled by default (MiMo V2.6 verified 2026-09-22).
Kimi K2.6 switches thinking on or off and keeps every earlier thinking turn (keep all) while enabled.
Kimi K2.7 Code always thinks: the request always enables thinking and sends no effort.
These Models always reason; none asks for the cheapest rung (low) instead of the higher default.

Go forwards Messages to Anthropic, where Claude Haiku 5.5 removed sampling parameters (catalog supports_temperature false in resources/wire/anthropic.json); temperature answers HTTP 400 "`temperature` is deprecated for this model" (live 2026-10-08), so they are never sent.
GLM 5.3 Flash drops calls to Tools that are not in the request's Tool list.

The gateway bills historical answer-turn Reasoning of every Qwen Model (verify_wire_profile replay check, live 2026-10-03). Qwen's own chat template keeps earlier Reasoning only with preserve_thinking, so answer turns drop it and Tool Call turns keep it.
